Cut 9 of the `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6421730179`. Four bodies of the "Execution plumbing" section move unedited into a new module, `packages/objectql/src/engine-execution-plumbing.ts`: `buildSession`, `buildProvenance`, `buildEvalUser` and `buildUser`, the builders of the caller envelopes a hook and a validation predicate read. No behaviour changes. #25522 stays open for the later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-3pdv8m` (the card thread's harness-pinned branch), cut from `origin/main` at `1eebbc08b`, which contains cut 8's merge (`43f1da0f6`, #26229). Nothing was edited before that merge landed.

The per-method move screen for every section and the full pricing are in the project file `pm-orders/server/25522-cut9-seam-table.md`. A body stays if any of these holds: an inferred-return public method, a U site, a private-static read, an `objectql/src/engine.ts#NAME` pointer under `packages/spec/**` or `docs/adr/**`, an engine self-call, or a static. Bodies earlier cuts moved count as stubs.

Pricing (net `engine.ts` lines, the seat's rule): a stub costs a comment, the host literal's open and close and the `.call`, plus two lines per field read and one per method read; a body that reads no member costs two (the comment and the call); the import adds about three.

| Autonumber | 80 of 613 | `adoptExplicitAutonumber` 19, `isIssuedAutonumberCollision` 5, `warnAutonumberReadersUnserved` 13, `seedAutonumber` 64 | about -75 | pays 20 lines more but holds over twice the recent lines; the next candidate |
| count / aggregate | 236 of 620 | `count` 58, `rejectCredentialAggregation` 38 | about -71 | hot |
| Migration flags and attestations | 81 of 683 | 8 bodies | about -91 | the section writes five fields, so its host needs setters (a seat ruling first, as cuts 7 and 8 said) |
| Package registration, Referential integrity, File-reference hydration, Readable-ids, Delete cascade, Driver options, validate | 170 to 733 | 161 to 469 | -120 to -439 | the hottest sections; the card says take the coldest |
| Query lowering, Hook dispatch internals, find, Roll-up summaries and the rest | - | - | -1 to -40 | pay little |

Cut 8 priced this area at about -55 and the head measures exactly -55 (66 lines removed, 11 added). Areas the seat rejected priced about -5 and -15; it accepted -70 to -117. No other area pays better while being as cold: Autonumber is the only one between -55 and -91 below 100 recent lines, and its 80 recent lines include #26026's edit during cut 7.

What stays in the section: `executeWithMiddleware` (ADR-0139 cites it as `engine.ts#executeWithMiddleware`), `buildReferentialFieldClear` (1 body line, the stub would cost 2) and `claimReferentialCascadeDelete` (5 body lines; it reads the `cascadeIssuedDeletes` field, so its stub would cost 6).

## The shape

- The class keeps all four methods with name, modifiers (`private`), signature, docblock and position. Each body is now one comment and one `return NAME(execCtx);`, marked `[#25522 cut 9]`, the form earlier cuts use for a member-free body (`objectDisplayLabel`, `assertBulkPerRowHookBudget`, `resolveSecret`).
- **No host object.** None of the four bodies reads `this` (AST screen, casts stripped): each is a function of the `ExecutionContext` it is handed. The card's rule is that shared state goes through one named host; here there is no shared state to hand over, so the module declares no host interface and imports nothing from the engine, not even as a type.
- **Imports.** The module's imports are `HookContext` (`@objectstack/spec/data`) and `ExecutionContext` (`@objectstack/spec/kernel`), both as types, the bindings `engine.ts` uses. `engine.ts` keeps every import it had (both still have readers there) and gains the new module import with a two-line comment.
- The module header names the four bodies, says what stays and why, and cites ADR-0068 and ADR-0139 by id only (no decision letter).

## Net lines (the seat's rule)

`engine.ts` goes from 23,095 to 23,040 lines, **net -55** (11 added, 66 removed). The module is 122 lines: a 38-line header and imports, four one-line docblocks, and the 66 moved body lines with their signatures and closing braces. With the one re-keyed row of the census page, the diff is 201 changed lines over 3 files (+134 / -67), far under the 3,000-line human-merge threshold.

## Proof of move-only

A TypeScript-AST leaf-token compare (recursive `getChildren`, JSDoc skipped; `pm-orders/server/evidence/25522/astcmp.mjs`) of base `engine.ts` (`1eebbc08b`) against the head module:

- For each of the four, the parameters, return type, type parameters and body tokens are **SAME**, `async` matches, and every body line equals the base line less two leading spaces, comments included: `buildSession` 205 tokens / 43 lines, `buildProvenance` 109 / 9, `buildEvalUser` 56 / 6, `buildUser` 72 / 8.
- **Negative controls:** flipping `!flowRunId` to `flowRunId` in the moved `buildProvenance` reports DIFFER on its body tokens; editing only one comment in the moved `buildUser` fails the line rule. Both exit 1, and the module was restored from `HEAD` and its blob hash compared after each.
- Class: 318 members at both ends, in the same order. 314 are byte-identical (full text, docblocks included), and the 4 stubs keep docblock, modifiers and signature byte-identical up to the body.
- Top level: 231 of 232 base statements are byte-identical in head; the other is the class. Head adds the new module import with its comment.

## Readers of the moved lines

- **The system-context census page (migrated in this PR).** `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 63 anchored `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts#buildSession`, the read site that carries `isSystem` into the hook session. The read now lives in the module, so the row anchors `packages/objectql/src/engine-execution-plumbing.ts#buildSession`; its wording is unchanged. `check-system-context-census` at base: 151 read sites in 22 packages across 79 files, 144 of 144 symbols cited; at head: 151 sites across 80 files, 144 of 144 cited, OK. **Control:** with the base page restored over this head, the gate exits 1 with exactly two findings, `file-without-a-row` for the new module and `anchor-is-not-a-read-site` for the old anchor; restored from `HEAD`, blob hash compared, green again.
- **ADR anchors.** No `scripts/adr-anchors/` entry describes a moved body: the engine entry's one paragraph is the transaction seam, and its ids stay cited in `engine.ts`. So no entry is added. `check-adr-anchors` at base `1eebbc08b` (clean detached worktree): 90 anchored files, **1,881** decision-letter citations; at head: 90 anchored files, **1,881** (resolving citations 59,224 → 59,226, the module header's two ADR ids). The moved bodies cite no decision letter; the docblocks that do (ADR-0090 D10 on `buildProvenance`) stay on the methods.
- No `objectql/src/engine.ts#NAME` pointer under `packages/spec/**` or `docs/adr/**` names the four. Prose that names a method by file (`packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts` on `buildSession()` in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, `script-runner.ts` on `buildUser()`, the plugin and test comments) still resolves, because every method stays on the class in `engine.ts`; none of them reads source text.
- No gate baseline keys a moved body (`durability-read-invention.baseline.json`, `query-options-erasure-baseline.json` and `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` name none of the four); `check-org-identifier`, which reads the session shape `buildSession` emits, is green.

- Next cut from this screen: Autonumber (about -75, four bodies, 80 recent lines). Migration flags still needs a setter ruling.
